title: Profile: A2A versions and wire dialects
goal: 0.3 and 1.x differences (part shapes, state enums, method names, agent card fields) as data the client uses to pick a dialect. Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
